scoring.note: Deterministic tasks (t01–t07) have a fixed reference answer and are the primary metric. Task t08 (check=judge) has no fixed reference — it is scored by a cheap LLM judge and its verdict is always tagged `judge`, never mixed into the deterministic score.

tasks.prompt: Compute (47 * 89) + 123. Reply with only the integer, no explanation.

Extract structured data from this text into a JSON object with EXACTLY these five keys: name, email, company, role, city. Reply with ONLY the JSON object, no markdown fence:

"Maria Petrova (maria.petrova@example.com) is CTO at Acme Robotics, based in Kazan."

List every named entity from the text below verbatim (company, person, email, phone, city). One per line, no extra commentary.

"Ivan Kuznetsov, ivan.kuznetsov@nordwind.ru, +7 903 210-44-55, is Head of Sales at Nordwind Logistics in Saint Petersburg."
Write a JavaScript function named `isPalindrome(s)` that returns true when `s` reads the same forwards and backwards, ignoring case and non-alphanumeric characters. Reply with the function only.

Write a JavaScript function named `fizzbuzz(n)` that returns an array of length n where multiples of 3 are "Fizz", multiples of 5 are "Buzz", multiples of both are "FizzBuzz", and other positions hold the number itself (1-indexed). Reply with the function only.

What does this Python program print? Reply with only the printed value.

```python
x = [i * i for i in range(5)]
print(sum(x))
```
